Easy Chocolate Beignets
By: The Southern Lady
Published: Thursday, July 8, 2010 - 3:16pm

Ingredients




1 can of biscuits
chocolate chips
3 inches Canola Oil in deep fryer or skillet
Confectionery sugar
Chocolate syrup

Preparation

1 Roll each biscuit into a circle 2 Add 4 chocolate chips in middle of circle 3 Fold the biscuit in half, pressing edges together. 4 Drop each biscuit into boiling oil around 350 degrees.(They will come to top as soon as you drop them in oil) 5 Turn to brown both sides 6 Remove from oil with slotted spoon 7 Roll in confectionery sugar 8 Drizzle with chocolate syrup.

About


We Southerners love beignets!  If you have ever been to Cafe du Monde in New Orleans and had their famous hickory coffee and beignets you know what I am talking about.   A beignet is a pastry made from dough and deep fried then rolled in confectioners sugar.  This is an easy way to make these little treats and you won’t be able to stop eating them!
